artifact.tides-of-war.artifacts.mdtBinoc:
{Binoculars}

Hero is under Vision spell and gains +4 sight radius.

An old scientist, right before breathing his last, gives you his newest invention, which makes very distant objects appear much closer. Though the scientist did not manage to present it to you on time and most of your army is quite scared of this thing, you take it anyway and name it... Binoculars.
artifact.tides-of-war.artifacts.mdtFireb:
{Fireball Wand}

Adds Fireball Wand spell to spellbook. Use it to cast Fireball spell for 2 spell points.

On your way you stumble upon a small patch of terrain covered in flames. In the middle of this place you see a wand, clearly emanating a magical power, stuck in the ground. You decide to grab the wand from the fire and keep it for yourself.
artifact.tides-of-war.artifacts.mdtIcebo:
{Ice Bolt}

Adds Ice Bolt Wand spell to spellbook. Use it to cast Ice Bolt spell for 2 spell points.

On your way you stumble upon a small patch of icebound terrain. In the middle of this place you see a wand, clearly emanating a magical power, stuck in the ground. You decide to grab the wand from the ice and keep it for yourself.
artifact.tides-of-war.artifacts.mdtMajor:
{Major Phylactery}

Summons scary Demiliches to help you in the battlefield.

A Necromancer comes across your way and wants to ask you some riddles. Though you say you have no time for such nonsense, he insists, causing you to annihilate him abruptly. As his dead corpse slumps to the ground, you discover a phylactery under his coat.

artifact.tides-of-war.artifacts.mdtShiel:
{Shield of the Ancients}

Increases hero's spellpower skill by +12 and casts Aura of Power at the beginning of every turn.

An abandoned fortress seems to be nothing much to the eye of an experienced adventurer. Nevertheless, you enter the outpost, as if some mysterious force dragged you in. You ignore valuable goods from the times of the Ancients lying in every corner, and move slowly towards a golden shield levitating above the ground.

{Shield Wand}

Adds Shield Wand spell to spellbook. Use it to cast Shield spell for 2 spell points.

On your way you stumble upon a small patch of terrain reminiscent of some hardened crust. In the middle of this place you see a wand, clearly emanating a magical power, stuck in the ground. You decide to grab the wand from the hardened soil and keep it for yourself.

artifact.tides-of-war.artifacts.mdtThird:
{Third Eye}

Gives heroes a chance to learn 5th level spells cast by enemy spellcasters in battles and decreases amount of enemy's creatures available spells by 1.

An old woman, seemingly some hag living in hermitage, is screaming at you right after you meet her, possibly due to her lack of sight. After a while of her effing and blinding, she suddenly hands you some sort of a golden bust and disappears in thin air.

{Sea Protector}
Mermaids can help to safe travel through whirlpools
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.eyzeaDemoniac.b: Eyzea presents herself as the real mother of Xeron, commander of the Sons of Erebus. When Eeofol lost the War of Armageddon's Blade, she had to hide underground, fearing for her life. Now she awaits the moment to return to the surface and lead the Kreegan army to their final victory.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.eyzeaDemoniac.s: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Succubi and Lilims for each level attained after 4th level. Additionally, Succubi and Lilims get a permanent +1 Speed bonus
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.kreevionHeretic: Rumor has it that Kreevion was born of pure wrath of Demons mourning the death of Lucifer Kreegan. Despite it most certainly being just a tale, this idea alone causes his subordinates to fear him.
Casts Frenzy with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtCharles.biog: For many years, Sir Charles had trained Paladins in Steadwick, but gave up being a tutor and started his career as a Dragon Hunter in Jadame. However, when the war had come, he came back to Erathia and began fighting for Morgan Kendal as a commander.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtCharles.name: Charles
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtCharles.spec: All Templars and Paladins always have positive morale.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtCollivea.bio: When young Collivea joined the forces of Nighon, Warlocks were amazed to find out that she's resistant to the look of a Medusa. That settled her career as an Overlord.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtCollivea.spe: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Medusas and Medusa Queens for each level attained after 4th level. Additionally, Medusas and Medusa Queens get a permanent +1 Speed bonus.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtDaxaroth.bio: Daxaroth was Dragon Queen Mutare's right paw. Some suspect that Mutare's death was really Daxaroth's plot to gain power. Nevertheless, Dragons listen to him as if he is their new King.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtDaxaroth.spe: All Dragons gain Wide Breath ability.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtErgon.biogra: After taking the throne of Krewlod, Kilgor brought Ergon to quell the rebellion of the Ogres who were still loyal to Winston Boragus, even after his death. Needless to say, the veteran of Succession Wars did his job very effectively by raiding the unruly tribes with his exotic beasts.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtErgon.name: Ergon
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtErgon.specia: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Couatls and Quetzalcouatls for each level attained after 6th level. Additionally, Couatls and Quetzalcouatls get a permanent +1 Speed bonus.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtEurydis.biog: By cutting down trees in the north of Steadwick, monsters of Deyja awakened the Forest's spirits. Eurydis miraculously avoided death and, with other Dryads, fled to AvLee. Here she gathered an army to avenge her murdered sisters.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtEurydis.name: Eurydis
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtEurydis.spec: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Dryads and Oak Dryads for each level attained after 4th level. Additionally, Dryads and Oak Dryads get a permanent +1 Speed bonus
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtGaluum.biogr: Many say that Galuum was once a slave trader, who, due to an ancient ritual, became a monster, but also a very powerful Warlock. No one, however, can prove these rumors. No matter if this legend is true, Galuum is a very talented leader, who frightens his enemies with not only his appearance, but also his skills.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtGaluum.name: Galuum
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtGaluum.speci: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Illithids and Alhoons for each level attained after 5th level. Additionally, Illithids and Alhoons get a permanent +1 Speed bonus.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtGhuri.biogra: Ghuri spent majority of his life looking after trees in Tularean Forest. In return, the trees have taught him their powerful Forest Magic.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtGhuri.name: Ghuri
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtGwenneth.bio: Gwenneth served Roland Ironfist during the Succession Wars as a Knight. When she arrived at Erathia in search for adventures, she discovered her new vocation. Now everyone knows Gwenneth as a great Cleric.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtGwenneth.spe: All ranged units have permament Air Shield.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtHokori.biogr: As a Priestess of the Temple of Baa, Hokori left Enroth and settled down in Erathia in order to spread her faith. Here she had an epiphany caused by the Conflux and thus she abandoned her religion so that she could stay among the Elementals.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtHokori.name: Hokori
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtHokori.speci: Casts Aura of Power with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtIrrigus.biog: Irrigus have never felt loyal to the Triton Empire, which occupies the whole Endless Ocean. Because of that, he gladly serves the Masters of the Elements after he felt called to the Conflux.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtIrrigus.name: Irrigus
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtIrrigus.spec: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Tritons and Abyssal Tritons for each level attained after 3rd level. Additionally, Tritons and Abyssal Tritons get a permanent +1 Speed bonus.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtOdetta.biogr: Even though Odetta's sight is good as new, she managed to improve it with a mixture of magic and technology. Now she is able to see even at the longest distances, which made her one of the best choices as a commander.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtOdetta.name: Odetta
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtOdetta.speci: Casts Precision with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtShroo.biogra: No one really knows how long Trolls live. Rumor has it that Shroo remember the days of the Revolt of the Beastmasters. No one though has been brave enough to ask her about it.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtShroo.name: Shroo
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtShroo.specia: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Troll Hags and Troll Witches for each level attained after 5th level. Additionally, Troll Hags and Troll Witches get a permanent +1 Speed bonus
Creature Bonus: Troll Witches and Troll Hags
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtTartarr.biog: Tartarr was born in poor Ogre family, but has always dreamed about conquests. She has become a soldier of fortune at the age of fourteen because of her adult look and stubbornness. This bullish Ogress often gets all that she wants due to her talents in defense magic.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtTartarr.name: Tartarr
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtTartarr.spec: Casts Shield with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtThyroc.biogr: Not everyone mourned King Tralossk after his death. Thyroc's old friend from war, Prince Wystan, contributed to his promotion in Tatalian Army after taking power.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtThyroc.name: Thyroc
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtThyroc.speci: Increases the speed of any Hydras or Chaos Hydras by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtVerstan.biog: Verstan has been fascinated by constructing Golems since childhood. His inquisitiveness and challenging questions often perplexed even the best constructors. Not much time has past before Gavin Magnus himself noticed Verstan's potential and ordered him constructing new kinds of Golems, based on the accomplishments of the Red Dwarves.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtVerstan.name: Verstan
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.mdtVerstan.spec: All Drake Golems and Dragon Golems gain additional 10% magic resistance.
hero.tides-of-war.heroes.yaverrDeathknig: When Kastore came to the throne of Deyja, many Undeads, as yet hiding in shadows, blatantly opposed the new authority. Yaverr, once hunting Harmondale's peasants alone, happened to be a very talented commander among the rebels.
Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Werewolves and Dire Werewolves for each level attained after 4th level. Additionally, Werewolves and Dire Werewolves get a permanent +1 Speed bonus
After Archibald Ironfist lost the Succession Wars, Zam decided to leave Enroth and settle down for good in Erathia. Hiding for years in his laboratory, by coincidence he heard the news about dethroning the old ruler of Deyja. Disappointed by unconventional methods of the new King, Zam has quickly withdrawn allegiance to him.
Casts Vampirism with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit (the bonus is greater when used on weaker units)
